text:
```yaml
name: Check Branch Alias

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  check-branch-alias:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up PHP
      uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
      with:
        php-version: '7.4'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader

    - name: Run wp i18n audit command with JSON format
      run: ./vendor/bin/wp i18n audit --format=json > audit.json

    - name: Run wp i18n audit command with GitHub Actions format
      run: ./vendor/bin/wp i18n audit --format=github-actions > audit-github-actions.txt

    - name: Check JSON output
      id: json-output
      run: |
        echo "::set-output name=json_output::$(cat audit.json)"

    - name: Check GitHub Actions output
      id: github-actions-output
      run: |
        echo "::set-output name=github_actions_output::$(cat audit-github-actions.txt)"

    - name: Compare branch alias
      run: |
        if [ "${{ steps.json-output.outputs.json_output }}" != "${{ steps.github-actions-output.outputs.github_actions_output }}" ]; then
          echo "Branch alias mismatch detected"
          exit 1
        else
          echo "Branch alias match confirmed"
        fi
```
